questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes a difference between transport in xylem and transport in phloem?

options.text: Xylem only transports upwards, while phloem can transport in both directions
Xylem transports sugars, while phloem transports water and minerals
Both xylem and phloem require active transport to move substances
Xylem transport is driven by gravity, while phloem transport is driven by osmosis

questions.explanation: Xylem transports water and minerals upwards only (from roots to leaves), while phloem can transport dissolved sugars both upwards and downwards depending on where the sources and sinks are located.
